```artifact
Feature: Offline Consultation and Payment

  Scenario: Offline Consultation Payments
    Given the user is on the Offline Consultation screen
    When the user selects a payment method
    Then the payment method should be vide

  Scenario: Credit/Debit/Net Banking Payment
    Given the user is on the Offline Consultation screen
    When the user selects a payment method
    And the user enters valid credit/debit/net banking details
    Then the payment should be processed successfully

  Scenario: Error Messages for Invalid Payment Methods
    Given the user is on the Offline Consultation screen
    When the user selects an invalid payment method
    Then an error message should appear at the bottom
    And the error message should be self-descriptive
    And the error message should not exceed 80 characters

  Scenario: Navigation Buttons
    Given the user is on the Offline Consultation screen
    When the user clicks on a navigation button
    Then the user should be redirected to the correct screen

  Scenario: Bigger Font Size for Elderly Users
    Given the user is on the Patient Registration or Consultation Requests screen
    Then the font size should be larger

  Scenario: Exception Error Message for Non-Existent Symptom
    Given the user is on the Offline Consultation screen
    When the user enters a non-existent symptom
    Then an exception error message should be displayed
    And the error message should be "Symptom does not exist"
```
